kaufe.en: I buy, I make the purchase

bloques.titulo: The verbal clamp with separable verbs
texto: The verbs with separable prefix (**aufstehen, anfangen, einkaufen, fernsehen**) form a syntactic clamp (* Satzklammer *) in the main sentence:
1. The base verb is conjugated and occupies the **segunda posición** (or the first in closed questions).
2. The separable prefix is placed in the **último lugar de la frase**, closing the idea:
If the phrase has several additions (time, day, company), they all go in the center of the clamp, between the conjugated verb and the final prefix.

filas: I get up early every day

frases.de: Wann stehst du am Samstag auf, Carlos?
frases.en: When do you get up on Saturday, Carlos?

frases.de: Ich stehe um neun Uhr auf. Und du?
frases.es: Me levanto a las nueve. ¿Y tú?
frases.en: I'm up at nine. And you?

frases.de: Ich stehe früh auf und kaufe am Samstag ein.
frases.es: Me levanto temprano y hago la compra el sábado.
frases.en: I get up early and do the shopping on Saturday.
analisis: I make the purchase on Saturday («ein» at the end)

frases.en: When does the language course begin?

frases.de: Der Sprachkurs fängt am Montag an. Am Abend sehen wir fern!
frases.es: El curso de idiomas empieza el lunes. ¡Por la noche vemos la tele!
frases.en: The language course begins on Monday. At night we watch TV!

frases.de: Ich stehe um sieben Uhr auf.
Am Abend sehen wir zusammen fern.
frases.es: Por la noche vemos la tele juntos.
frases.en: At night we watch TV together.

bloques.pregunta: In a main sentence with a separable verb like «aufstehen», where is the «auf» prefix placed?

opciones.texto: At the absolute end of the prayer.
opciones.explicacion: The conjugated verb goes in position 2 and the separable prefix closes the sentence.
The separable particle is moved at the end of the sentence.
The prefix is never placed in front of the subject.

bloques.pregunta: You mean «I start at nine.» with the separable verb «anfangen». What's the right way?

opciones.texto: Ich fange um neun Uhr an.
opciones.explicacion: The verb «fange» occupies position 2 and the prefix «an» goes to the end.
The «an-» prefix should be separated in the main sentence.

opciones.texto: Ich fange an um neun Uhr.
opciones.explicacion: The separable prefix goes to the end of all the supplements.

bloques.pregunta: How do you ask the «You're buying today?» closed question with «einkaufen»?

opciones.explicacion: The conjugated verb «Kaufst» goes in position 1 and «ein» at the end.
You cannot leave the prefix attached at the beginning of the question.
The correct order is verb (1) + subject (2) + complement + prefix (final).
«Aufstehen»: the «auf» separable prefix closes the sentence.
«An» is the «anfangen» prefix, not to get up.
«Anfangen»: the separable particle «an» goes to the end.
«Fernsehen»: conjugated verb «sehen» and particle «fern» at the end.
He doesn't mention friends or go out.

opciones.texto: At night we read a book.

intro: The separable verbs are one of the most characteristic structures of the German: the base verb is conjugated in second position and its prefix travels to the absolute end of the sentence.
